newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers stable, buying healthy in ARA.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers stable, buying healthy in ARA.

text.p: European bunker prices were little changed on Wednesday and activity in most parts muted, but the ARA region registered demand of around 15,000 tonnes, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers were steady, trading around $114 fob by the close. Two large enquiries, together totalling 6,000 tonnes, emerged and a major sold to each party at $113.50, dealers said. Other smaller enquiries also came in, leaving most sellers satisfied.
Hamburg prices moved away from those of Rotterdam, the difference for 380 CST being $5/$6 a tonne.
The result was very slack trading. Dealers said buyers were still waiting in the hope of lower prices.
French and Italian demand was healthy, but Spain and the eastern Mediterranean managed few sales.
The Durban market was unable to quote fuel oil prices as shortages continued to bite. Traders said the market had not recovered after the maintenance at one refinery.
Fujairah bunkers were stable in line with steady fuel oil cargo markets.
